shantae.name: Shantae
shantae.backstory: A half-genie guardian from a seaside town of pirates and potions, Shantae has saved her home more times than she can count and still found time to dance. She came to Hollowmere on a magical errand that fizzled out, and stayed once she saw the stage. She is cheerful, impulsive and always ready to whip her hair around.

design.hairStyle: extremely long high ponytail reaching her ankles
design.features: pointed ears, gold hoop earrings and a slim gold circlet

sig_shantae.label: Half-genie dancer
sig_shantae.prompt: a magenta bandeau top and sheer purple harem pants with a gold waist chain, bare feet

sp_shantae.label: Veiled dancer
sp_shantae.prompt: a gem-trimmed turquoise and gold dancer set with a sheer veil skirt

risky.note: Her longtime rival, forever scheming to steal her magic.

rotty.note: Fast friends who share every adventure.

unique.name: Belly Dance
unique.desc: Her hair whips and her hips sway, and every audience falls under her spell.

risky.name: Risky Boots
risky.title: Captain
risky.backstory: The self-styled queen of the seven seas, Risky Boots lost her ship in a gamble she insists was rigged and washed up in Hollowmere with a plan and a grudge. She fully intends to steal the house out from under its owner, but the profits keep making her stay another week. She calls it patience.

design.hairStyle: long wavy black hair with side-swept bangs
design.features: dark lipstick and a wicked smirk
design.gear: a skull-badged tricorn hat, a cutlass and a long coat of purple velvet

sig_risky.label: Pirate captain
sig_risky.prompt: a purple corset bodice, a short black skirt, thigh-high leather boots and a studded belt

sp_risky.label: Captain's gown
sp_risky.prompt: a dark crimson silk gown with gold trim and a plunging neckline

shantae.note: The half-genie who keeps foiling her schemes.

unique.name: Dread Captain
unique.desc: A born schemer who commands attention and a slice of every deal.

rotty.name: Rottytops
rotty.backstory: A cheerful zombie girl from a ramshackle seaside town, Rottytops refuses to let a little thing like being dead slow her down. She wandered into Hollowmere following the smell of a good party and decided to stay for the late shifts. Nobody has ever caught her in a bad mood, even at dawn.

design.features: visible stitches at her neck and wrists and a gap-toothed grin

sig_rotty.label: Patchwork tunic
sig_rotty.prompt: a patched striped crop tunic, a ragged short skirt and mismatched stockings

sp_rotty.label: Gothic gown
sp_rotty.prompt: a tattered black lace gown with sheer sleeves and ribbons

shantae.note: Fast friends who share every adventure.

unique.name: Undead Constitution
unique.desc: She never seems to tire, and her sunny mood keeps the night shift lively.
